title: SizeUp SC for South Carolina Communities | Big Data for South Carolina Small Businesses

facts.fact: Through the state's partnership with SizeUp, the SC Department of Commerce offers small businesses and entrepreneurs across South Carolina data to benchmark against competitors.
facts.quote: Through the state’s partnership with SizeUp, the Department of Commerce offers small businesses and entrepreneurs across the state data to benchmark themselves against their competition

facts.fact: South Carolina communities can incorporate SizeUp into their small business ecosystem at a reduced rate because of the existing state partnership.
facts.quote: Now, communities in South Carolina can incorporate SizeUp into their small business and entrepreneurial ecosystem, at a reduced rate due to the existing state partnership.

facts.fact: The page states that local businesses will have free access to SizeUp SC's program features.
facts.quote: Now your local businesses will have free access to:

facts.fact: Local SizeUp data will be customized to a community's geography and will add hourly wage, open hours, digital footprint, and in-depth demographics to the existing statewide datasets.
facts.quote: This data will be customized to your local geography and will include the existing statewide data sets, plus additional information to aid your local businesses: hourly wage, open hours, digital footprint, and in-depth demographics

facts.fact: The SizeUp community tool is stated to be available to local businesses and entrepreneurs 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, on the community's Chamber, EDO, or City website.
facts.quote: available to your local small businesses and entrepreneurs, 24/7, 365 days a year.

facts.fact: SizeUp SC is available for any South Carolina geography, including cities, counties, regions, and districts.
facts.quote: Any and every South Carolina geography

facts.fact: SizeUp SC is available for government, public-private partnership, Chamber of Commerce, and Small Business Development Center organizations.
facts.quote: Any and every South Carolina type of organization

facts.fact: SizeUp's vendor states its business performance comparison draws on millions of data points.
facts.quote: SizeUp super-crunches millions of data points so businesses know where they rank.

facts.fact: The Open Hours dataset measures when businesses in an industry are open, shown for each day of the week, weekdays, weekends, and the total week.
facts.quote: The data is shown in multiple ways so that you can see the difference for each day of the week, weekdays, weekends, and the total week.

facts.fact: The demographics tool maps demographic, labor force, and consumer expenditure data, tailored to the area around an address or to a custom boundary.
facts.quote: Interactively map demographic, labor force, and consumer expenditure data for your area. Tailor your analysis to the area around your address, or to a custom boundary.
